==Description==
The '''Engineer Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 6 [[Engineer]]. AAnybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Engineer]].  If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The rebar launcher of the '''Engineer Plush''' is detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 12 inches (30.48 cm) tall, 10.5 inches (26.67 cm) wide and 7.48 inches (19 cm) long. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Engineer Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Third)'''
*:This Engineer Plush is armed and ready and you know her aim is steady. Her weapon is attachable via Velcro for a quick setup when she needs to defend. This plush does not include an in-game reward. 
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:This Engineer Plush is armed and ready and you know her aim is steady. Her weapon is attachable via Velcro for a quick setup when she needs to defend. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:This Engineer Plush is armed and ready - you know her aim is steady. Her weapon is attachable via Velcro for a quick setup when she needs to defend.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Engineer Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for for $34.99. If bought as part of the Engineer Bundle, which also includes the [[Engineer]] pin, it costs $43.18.

Before April 2025, the '''Engineer Plush''' could be purchased for $29.99, while the bundle could be purchased for $35.98. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49, while the bundle had a cost of $23.83. During the Black Friday 2025 Sale, it could be bought for $28.99.
